steps.what: Clarify the actual public question about available postal services, destination or applicable postal requirements.
Find current approved service and postal-requirement source pages in {DOCS} for the actual question.
Check the actual guidance's scope, current version and exceptions before deciding what information can responsibly be given.
Inform the public of available services, and of postal laws and regulations, explaining the verified information and answering actual follow-up questions.
Write and check the requested written service explanation in {EMAIL}, using verified source references and checking its meaning and customer recipient.
outputs: Checked exact written explanation and recipient

steps.what: Send the exact checked written explanation to the verified customer through {EMAIL}.
inputs: Exact explanation and recipient checked in s5

tasks.design: Configure native topic and destination views for approved postal guidance in {DOCS}, plus approved reference fields in {EMAIL}. The worker checks applicability, explains the actual answer personally and checks the completed written follow-up before its separate send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current service guidance and reusable references are manually located.
tasks.enabler_now: Native indexed guidance and approved reference fields.
tasks.still_hard: Exceptions, customer understanding and the actual applicability of postal requirements.
tasks.human_edge: Clear explanation and responsible escalation of uncertain cases.

ambition.what: No automated legal advice service is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less source retrieval; service explanation stays human.

reach.learn: Source version control and accessible explanation

evidence.claim: Native guidance views can assist postal information retrieval while current applicability and explanation remain human.

assumptions: Conditional cycle includes an actual question and requested written follow-up; it is not a mandatory report for every counter conversation. Shares are E1 estimates rather than measured postal baselines.

Worker produces context in s1. Existing guidance publishers supply topic, destination/scope, approved version and source text; missing fields require manual source reading in s2-s3. No free transcript or structured legal-eligibility code is assumed.

Test native search and approved reference fields first. Only source retrieval and repeated reference placement change; new explanation and meaning checks remain human. National postal requirements must be checked locally; no specific rule is invented.
s5 checks the final actual follow-up and recipient; edits void the gate. Sending is short and fully retained, with no existing-runtime saving.
research_questions: Can native scope and topic views reduce actual lookup without concealing exceptions?

already_counted.description: Actual question, residual lookup, applicability judgment, explanation, written meaning check and send remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain approved guidance tags and references.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final explanation and customer recipient checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15 x 40% source retrieval + 9 x 20% reference placement = 7.8 gross less 1 upkeep. Already indexed guidance yields zero; explanation and send remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Examine the actual customer's money-order request, identity evidence and presented instrument where applicable under the existing authorised counter procedure.
outputs: Actual request details and observed evidence

steps.what: Retrieve the actual instrument status, applicable service requirements and transaction reference in the authorised postal counter transaction system {OTHER}.
inputs: Actual request and instrument reference from s1

steps.what: Capture the actual issue or cashing transaction details in the postal counter draft {OTHER}, selecting the actual amount, customer and instrument.
Check the completed transaction draft, actual identity and instrument evidence, eligibility and authority before accepting the physical tender.
outputs: Checked exact transaction and permitted tender

steps.what: Accept the actual funds for issue or the actual original instrument for cashing within the checked transaction and existing counter procedure.
Verify actual received tender, final amount, available funds where needed and the completed transaction record before issue or redemption is committed.
inputs: Completed actual draft and checked evidence
outputs: Checked exact final issue or redemption record

steps.what: Commit the exact checked issue or redemption transaction in the authorised postal counter system {OTHER}.
inputs: Exact final record checked in s6
outputs: Committed actual transaction and existing system-issued instrument where applicable

steps.what: Physically check the actual issued instrument or count the actual payout against the committed transaction and intended customer before handover.
inputs: Actual issued instrument or payout funds
outputs: Checked exact instrument or counted payout and customer

steps.what: Issue and cash money orders by handing over the exact checked issued instrument or actual counted payout to the verified customer.
inputs: Exact instrument or payout and customer checked in s8
outputs: Actual completed issue or payout handover

tasks.design: Configure native status views and reusable established transaction fields in the authorised postal counter system {OTHER}. Keep actual identity checks, tender, final transaction verification, commit and physical issue or payout human; no new money-order decision engine is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Applicable status and repeated counter fields are manually retrieved or entered.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked status views and existing verified-field defaults.
tasks.still_hard: Authenticity, entitlement and actual funds handling.
tasks.human_edge: Observing the real customer, instrument and counted funds.

ambition.what: No autonomous financial service is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Small clerical reduction; transaction authority and counter controls remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Native counter views and verified-field defaults may reduce clerical retrieval while identity, instrument and funds checks remain human.

assumptions: Use only where this service is actually offered and the worker is authorised; EU counterpart and national requirements need local confirmation. Shares are E1 estimates across actual issue/cashing transactions, not a claim that every transaction contains both branches.

Worker observes real request, identity and instrument in s1. Existing authorised system supplies reference, status and current requirements in s2; actual amount and customer selection are captured in s3. Missing or conflicting evidence remains manual. s5 receives issue funds or the original redemption instrument, not an invented payment event in both branches.

Test native views and defaults first. Defaults cover repeated established fields only; actual tender, amount, identity, draft checks and physical handling retain all time. Existing instrument issuance runtime belongs to the authorised counter system and earns no labour saving; s7 records the operator's real commit action only.

Final tender verification follows actual receipt. The physical handover gate follows checking the actually issued instrument or counted payout, not an earlier draft. Edits or changed tender void relevant gates. No extra self-approval stage or automated cashing decision is introduced.
research_questions: Which native views reduce actual retrieval while preserving all existing financial and physical controls?

already_counted.description: Actual evidence, residual lookup and capture, all financial checks, tender, commit and physical handover remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain permitted defaults and status-view mappings.

approvals.approved_version: Exact transaction and permitted tender checked in s4
Exact final transaction with actual received tender checked in s6
Actual issued instrument or counted payout and customer checked in s8

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15 x 30% status retrieval + 15 x 20% repeated fields = 7.5 gross less 1 upkeep. Already configured counters yield zero; all funds, identity and action time remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Identify the actual customer's post office box account and requested rental period at the counter.
outputs: Actual box account and requested period

steps.what: Retrieve actual rent due, existing payments and applicable period from the postal box-rental system {OTHER}.
outputs: Actual account balance and period source

steps.what: Prepare the actual box-rent collection draft in the postal counter system {OTHER}, linking the selected account, period and due amount.
inputs: Actual account and due-period source from s2

steps.what: Check the completed collection draft against the real box account, period, due balance, payer and permitted payment method before taking payment.
Collect rents for post office boxes by actually receiving and checking the customer's payment for the exact checked rental transaction.
inputs: Exact collection request checked in s4

steps.what: Capture the actual received payment amount, method and reference in the box-rental payment draft {OTHER}.
Reconcile the completed rent-payment record to the actual received funds, box account and period before marking rent paid.
Commit the exact checked rent-payment record in the box-rental system {OTHER}.
inputs: Exact actual payment record checked in s7

steps.what: Produce the actual payment receipt from the posted rent transaction in the counter system {OTHER}.
inputs: Actual posted rent payment from s8

steps.what: Check the actual produced receipt against the posted payment, correct box account, period and intended customer.
Hand the exact checked box-rent payment receipt to the verified customer.
inputs: Exact receipt and customer checked in s10

tasks.design: Configure native account-balance views and verified rental-field reuse in the box-rental/counter system {OTHER}. The worker checks the customer and collection draft, receives real payment, reconciles the final record and separately commits it, produces the receipt and hands over the checked receipt.
tasks.previous_blocker: Rental balance and period details are manually found and repeated in the counter draft.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked account views and established field defaults.
tasks.still_hard: Actual payer identity, funds receipt and correct period allocation.
tasks.human_edge: Handling real payment and resolving account discrepancies.

ambition.what: No unattended rent-collection or automatic debit service is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Small retrieval and repeated-field reduction; payment responsibility stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Linked account views can reduce manual rental-data retrieval while real collection and payment reconciliation remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is an actual counter rental payment and its existing receipt. Shares are E1 estimates, not measured postal baselines. Online automatic collection is not treated as today's focal labour.

Worker establishes real box account and requested period in s1. Existing rental process supplies account id, period, due balance, current rate and prior payments; missing or inconsistent data requires manual investigation in s2-s4. Actual payment evidence is produced in s5 and captured explicitly in s6, never inferred from a draft or due date.

Test native account linking first. s3 reuses established account and due-period fields only, not payment evidence. Actual collection, record capture, reconciliation, commit, receipt production and delivery all retain full time.

Each gate follows its actual completed artefact or payment draft. Receipt checking occurs after receipt production. Changes void the relevant gate; no added self-approval stage, runtime or save-tail saving.
research_questions: Can native rental views reduce actual copying while keeping receipt of funds and allocation explicitly verified?

already_counted.description: Actual customer work, residual lookup and draft work, all payment, record, reconciliation and receipt actions remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain linked rental-period and account mappings.

approvals.approved_version: Exact collection request checked in s4
Exact actual payment record reconciled in s7
Actual produced receipt and customer checked in s10

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 10 x 40% balance retrieval + 15 x 25% repeated rental fields = 7.75 gross less 1 upkeep. Already linked accounts yield zero; funds and receipt actions retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Obtain supply bids, requisition and disburse funds

steps.what: Read the actual proposed supply need, approved budget and applicable purchasing requirements in {PROCUREMENT}.
Confer with suppliers to obtain bids for proposed purchases, clarifying actual supply specifications, price conditions and delivery commitments.
Read and compare the actual supplier bids in {PROCUREMENT}, locating price, quantity, delivery and exception terms for the proposed purchase.
inputs: Actual bids and clarifications from s2

steps.what: Decide the justified requisition and permitted supplier choice against actual need, bid conditions, budget and national or organisational purchasing requirements.
outputs: Actual requisition decision and authority limits

steps.what: Prepare the actual supply requisition draft in {PROCUREMENT} using the decided items, quantities, bid references and budget allocation.
Check the completed requisition's actual need, supplier terms, amounts, budget allocation and delegated authority before submission.
Submit the exact checked requisition into the authorised internal purchasing process in {PROCUREMENT}.
When the real purchase has progressed, verify actual invoice, purchase authorisation and goods-receipt evidence in {ERP} before preparing any disbursement.
outputs: Verified actual payable and disbursement basis

steps.what: Prepare the actual payment draft in {BANK} from the verified payable, using the established authorised supplier account and actual invoice reference.
Check the completed bank-payment draft against actual payable evidence, beneficiary details, amount, timing, duplication and existing disbursement authority.
inputs: Actual payable and authorised beneficiary evidence

steps.what: Disburse funds by releasing the exact checked actual payment through {BANK} under the existing authorised payment arrangement.

tasks.design: Configure native bid views and verified-field reuse in {PROCUREMENT}, plus established payment templates in {BANK}. Keep supplier discussion, purchasing judgment, real receipt/invoice verification and final payment checks human, with separate requisition submission and bank release.
tasks.previous_blocker: Bid terms and established fields are repeatedly found and copied into requisition and payment drafts.
tasks.enabler_now: Native purchasing views and verified reusable fields.
tasks.still_hard: Value for the actual need, exceptions and lawful disbursement authority.
tasks.human_edge: Supplier discussion and accountable purchasing/payment judgment.

ambition.what: No autonomous purchasing or payment authority is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less clerical preparation, with spending rights unchanged.

evidence.claim: Native procurement views and established payment templates can reduce clerical preparation while sourcing decisions and payment authorisation remain human.

assumptions: Boundary covers the focal worker's real sourcing, requisition and delegated disbursement across the actual purchase cycle. Shares are E1 estimates. National and organisational requirements replace US federal wording; no specific rule or limit is invented.

Worker establishes need in s1, obtains real bids in s2 and reads their actual item, quantity, price, delivery and exception terms in s3. Native views only help where bids already have usable fields; narrative-only bids need manual comparison and lower saving. s4 supplies the real selection and s5 captures the actual requisition; no free structured supplier-decision feed.

Existing purchasing, receiving and finance processes still produce the purchase authorisation, actual goods receipt, invoice id, amount and authorised supplier account. Their labour is unchanged, not newly transferred or saved. s8 verifies real evidence after it exists; submitting a requisition or reaching a calendar date never proves delivery or payment readiness.

Test native purchasing views, requisition fields and bank templates first. Reuse only established verified fields; new purchase content and all authority checks remain human. Existing required separation of duties remains; if this worker lacks bank-release authority, the unchanged authorised finance action is outside focal savings and the denominator must be repriced.

Gates bind the actual completed requisition and actual completed bank draft after checks. Changes void them. Short submission/release actions retain full time; no automatic order, receipt or existing runtime is counted as saved.
unknowns: Actual delegated spending and bank authority
research_questions: Which native views and established-field templates reduce actual preparation while keeping receipt evidence and payment approval separate?

already_counted.description: Actual needs, supplier discussion, residual comparison and drafts, decisions, receipt verification and final actions remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain bid-view, requisition and authorised payment-template fields.

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed requisition checked in s6
Exact actual payable payment draft checked in s10 under existing required authorisations

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15 x 30% bid retrieval + 15 x 30% requisition fields + 6 x 20% payment fields = 10.2 gross less 1.5 upkeep. Already configured or narrative-only sources may yield zero; supplier, authority and funds actions retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Customer service, actual funds handling and spending authority remain human.
role.ambitious_version: A postal manager who reduces repeated retrieval and field entry while retaining direct customer service, real payment controls and supplier judgment.
